note: LLM-judged behavioral evals. Each case targets one failure mode; expectations are binary. Dimensions: note threshold (accept, reject local), spec loop (proposal-only, promotion), setup, gate-failure repair, archive/freeze, notes audit. Run: bun scripts/run-eval.ts agent-notes

evals.prompt:
We just decided: the Ordering module and the Billing module will communicate only through domain events on our message bus — no direct HTTP calls and no shared database tables between them. We picked this over synchronous REST calls because Billing must keep accepting orders during its nightly reprocessing window, even though events make debugging harder. We know most teams would default to REST here.

The decision is already implemented in this PR. The repo has .agents/notes/README.md plus .agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-05-02-monorepo.md and .agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-05-10-postgres.md; neither covers communication between modules. Today is 2026-09-29. Apply the agent-notes skill: should this be recorded, and if so show exactly what you would write.
evals.expected_output: Durable rationale the code does not explain, so a note is warranted. The decision shipped in this PR, so it goes straight to .agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-09-29-<slug>.md with the exact header block, ## Problem first, a present-tense ## Decision, ## Alternatives considered naming synchronous REST and why it lost, and ## Consequences naming the debugging cost. No proposal-era sections. States that it checked existing notes for an owner.
expectations: The output decides this decision SHOULD be recorded as an Agent Note
The note path is .agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-09-29-<kebab-slug>.md
The note starts with '# Agent Note: <title>', a blank line, then exactly 'Status: implemented'
The body opens with ## Problem and includes ## Decision, ## Alternatives considered, and ## Consequences
## Alternatives considered names synchronous REST (or HTTP calls) and why it lost
## Consequences mentions the accepted cost (harder debugging)
The note contains no ## Proposal, ## Plan, ## Acceptance criteria, or ## Risks section
The output mentions checking existing notes for one that already owns this decision

evals.prompt: Two changes in this PR: (1) I moved the 'Export' button on the report page from the bottom toolbar to the top-right corner because it was hard to find, and (2) I renamed a local variable `tmp` to `rows` inside one function. Nothing else changed. Apply the agent-notes skill: do either of these need an Agent Note? Decide and explain.
evals.expected_output: Neither qualifies: both are local edits (a local UI presentation tweak and a mechanical local rename) with no lasting rationale. The agent says so briefly and writes no note.
expectations: The output decides that NEITHER change needs an Agent Note
The output gives the reason: both are local or mechanical edits with no lasting decision rationale
The output does not create or draft any note content or file path
The output does not use diff size alone as the reason

evals.prompt:
Repo: a TypeScript API with Hono, tests run with `bun test`, lefthook for pre-commit. .agents/notes/ exists with a README and a few implemented notes; none covers exports. Today is 2026-09-29.

I want to add PDF export of compliance reports so reviewers stop copying analyzer output into Word by hand. We have not decided whether to render server-side or use the browser's print dialog. Apply the agent-notes skill: investigate and write the proposal. Do NOT implement it.
evals.expected_output: Writes .agents/notes/proposed/feature/2026-09-29-<slug>.md with Status: proposed, a solution-independent ## Problem, ## Proposal, ## Alternatives considered comparing server-side rendering and browser print, ## Acceptance criteria where each criterion names an observable outcome and a falsifying check, and ## Risks including what is given up. Surfaces the undecided rendering choice to the user. Writes no code, routes, or tests.
expectations: The note path is .agents/notes/proposed/feature/2026-09-29-<kebab-slug>.md
The header is '# Agent Note: <title>', blank line, 'Status: proposed'
## Problem describes the reviewers' manual copying without presupposing a solution
The note has ## Proposal, ## Alternatives considered, ## Acceptance criteria, and ## Risks
## Alternatives considered compares server-side rendering with browser print-to-PDF and says why one loses
Each acceptance criterion is observable and names a concrete check (a bun test, an API call, or a runtime path) that could prove it false
The output flags the open rendering choice for the user rather than presenting it as decided
The output does not write implementation code, routes, or test files

evals.prompt:
The PDF export feature is implemented. Checks run: `bun test src/reports` (12 pass), `curl localhost:3000/reports/42/pdf` returned a valid PDF, and `curl localhost:3000/reports/999/pdf` returned 404. The owning note is .agents/notes/proposed/feature/2026-09-20-pdf-export.md:

```md
# Agent Note: PDF export of compliance reports

Status: proposed

## Problem

Reviewers copy analyzer output into Word by hand to share it.

## Proposal

We will add GET /reports/:id/pdf, rendered server-side from the existing report model.

## Alternatives considered

**Browser print-to-PDF.** Loses because layout varies by browser.

## Acceptance criteria

- Exporting an existing report returns a PDF whose findings match the JSON report.
- A missing report returns 404.

## Risks

- Adds a PDF rendering dependency.
```

Apply the agent-notes skill: finish the lifecycle for this note.
evals.expected_output: Moves the note with git mv to .agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-09-20-pdf-export.md (date unchanged), sets Status: implemented, rewrites ## Proposal into a present-tense ## Decision, folds acceptance and risks into ## Consequences and ## Verification listing the checks actually run with results, keeps ## Problem and ## Alternatives considered, leaves no proposal-era headings, and runs check-notes.ts.
expectations: The note moves to .agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-09-20-pdf-export.md, keeping the 2026-09-20 date
The status line becomes exactly 'Status: implemented'
## Proposal is rewritten as ## Decision in the present tense
The promoted note has no ## Proposal, ## Acceptance criteria, or ## Risks headings
A ## Verification (or ## Consequences) section lists bun test src/reports and both curl checks with their outcomes
The rendering-dependency risk survives as a consequence
## Alternatives considered is preserved
The output runs or instructs running check-notes.ts after the move

evals.prompt:
Apply the agent-notes skill to audit whether this repo still follows its decisions.

.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-06-11-events-between-contexts.md — ## Decision: "Ordering and Billing communicate via domain events only, never synchronous HTTP. Events are published by src/ordering/events/publisher.ts."
.agents/notes/proposed/feature/2026-09-01-pdf-export.md — a proposal, not built.

Facts:
- src/billing/client.ts line 9: `await http.post('http://ordering.internal/api/orders/confirm', ...)`
- src/ordering/events/publisher.ts does not exist; publishing moved to src/ordering/outbox.ts.
- check-notes.ts passes.

Produce the audit.
evals.expected_output: Rows: (1) decision violation at src/billing/client.ts:9 with both ways out (fix the code or supersede the note); (2) stale fact: the note names src/ordering/events/publisher.ts, now src/ordering/outbox.ts, fixed by updating the note in place. The proposal is not audited against code. check-notes passing is reported. At most three ranked next actions, nothing applied.
expectations: The audit reports the HTTP call at src/billing/client.ts:9 as a violation of the events-only decision
The violation offers both ways out: fix the code, or supersede the note with a new one
The audit reports the stale path src/ordering/events/publisher.ts (now src/ordering/outbox.ts) and proposes updating the note in place
The audit does not treat the proposed pdf-export note as a violation because it is not built
The audit ends with three or fewer ranked next actions and applies no fix
